2. The present writ petition has been preferred for direction to the respondent-authorities to make sufficient, adequate and satisfactory payment as compensation for acquired land with compound interest to the petitioner as per the new rules of land acquisition in the light of judgment of Hon'ble High Court as well as Hon'ble Apex Court.

3. In paragraph-8, it has been stated by the petitioner Patna High Court CWJC No.1543 of 2024(2)
